name: Veggie Pizza
description: A simple and customizable veggie pizza using crescent rolls as the crust, topped with a cream cheese mixture and various vegetables.
recipeIngredient: Veggies (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, celery, red or green peppers, green onions)

recipeInstructions.text: Roll out crescent rolls on a cookie sheet and a small cake pan. Bake until golden brown. Cool.
Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, cream cheese, and ranch dressing to make the cream mixture.
Spread cream mixture on cooled rolls.
Top with finely chopped vegetables of your choice.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Chill and cut into small pieces. Serve as hors d'oeuvres.

_similar.name: Stuffed Pita Pockets
_similar.description: A refreshing appetizer featuring mini pita pockets filled with a creamy ranch and feta cheese mixture, topped with cucumbers and tomatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the softened cream cheese, mayonnaise, and powdered ranch dressing mix until well combined.
Crumble feta cheese into the cream cheese mixture and stir to combine.
Cut the mini pita pockets in half and fill with the cheese mixture.
Top with diced cucumbers and tomatoes.
Serve and enjoy.

_similar.keywords: pita pockets, ranch dip, feta cheese, appetizer

_similar.name: Artichoke Appetizer
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy artichoke appetizer perfect for serving with bread or crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain artichoke hearts.
Combine artichoke hearts with cheese, mayonnaise, garlic salt, and green onion in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle parsley over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with bread or crackers.

_similar.keywords: artichoke appetizer, cheesy dip, party snack

_similar.name: Fairest Wheels
_similar.description: A chilled, rolled tortilla snack filled with a spicy chicken and cheese mixture.
recipeIngredient: ⅔ cup chopped green bell pepper
⅓ cup minced green onions and red pepper

recipeInstructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine chicken, lettuce, cheddar cheese.
In another bowl, beat cream cheese and sour cream together until smooth.
Add the cream cheese mixture to the chicken mixture and mix well.
Spread ⅓ cup of the chicken and cream cheese mixture onto one side of a tortilla, leaving a ½-inch border at the top.
Sprinkle with ⅓ cup shredded cheese and top with red pepper jelly.
Roll up the tortilla tightly and seal the edge.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling mixture.
Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Trim the ends off each roll and cut into 8 slices.
Serve cold.

_similar.keywords: chicken roll-ups, cheese snack, cold appetizer

_similar.name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
_similar.description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

_similar.keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Hot Cheese Dip
_similar.description: A creamy bacon and cheddar dip baked inside a pumpernickel bread shell.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the pumpernickel loaf and hollow it out, leaving a thick shell.
Mix the cream cheese, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, and bacon bits until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the hollowed-out bread.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil, leaving the hole with the cheese mixture uncovered.
Bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.
Serve hot with the bread pieces.

_similar.keywords: pumpernickel dip, hot bacon dip, cheddar dip
